People: George Lyttelton (author, Wikidata Q336899), died 1773; Elizabeth Montagu (author, Wikidata Q443320), died 1800; Henry Morley (editor, Wikidata Q2401379), died 1894. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Lyttelton, George Lyttelton, Baron, 1709-1773; Montagu, Mrs. (Elizabeth), 1718-1800; Morley, Henry, 1822-1894 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Dialogues of the dead. By George Lord Lyttleton. [sic].  1795, 1795, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_dialogues-of-the-dead-b_lyttelton-george-lyttel_1795. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 85%, 92%, 87% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Elizabeth Montagu, Henry Morley, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
